title: Summer Vibes
description: Make your World look way better for the 2 Week Minecraft Phase. Gives me July vibes
body:
**Description:**

SummerVibesShader is a lightweight color-grading shader pack for Iris and OptiFine that turns any Minecraft world into a warm, sun-drenched summer scene. Instead of rebuilding the entire rendering pipeline with shadow maps, ray tracing, or volumetric lighting, it works as a fast overlay on top of vanilla rendering — meaning almost everything you already know about how your world looks stays the same, just brighter, warmer, and more alive.

At its core is a global composite pass that pushes saturation and warmth across every biome, so greens feel lusher, sand feels sun-baked, and skies feel more dramatic, all wrapped in a soft vignette that pulls focus toward the center of the screen. On top of that, water gets its own dedicated treatment: instead of the flatter vanilla blue, it's tinted into a bright turquoise lagoon color that reacts to in-world lighting, so oceans, rivers, and pools all feel more tropical and inviting. The sun and moon get a golden-hour glow layered on, making sunrises and sunsets hit harder and giving even daytime skies a warmer, more cinematic edge.

Because it skips the heavy stuff — no shadow rendering, no reflections, no post-processing chains — it runs well on almost any setup that supports Iris or OptiFine, from low-end laptops to beefy gaming rigs. It's built for people who want their world to feel like an endless July afternoon without sacrificing performance, whether that's for survival play, building, content creation, or just wanting your builds to look their absolute best in screenshots and videos.

In short: it's not trying to be a full realism overhaul, it's a fast, punchy, vibe-focused shader that makes summer the permanent season.
